Strong examples are M2927:25 microlitres of 100mg/mL azlocillin and flucloxacillin become25G_PER_L; M3155:0.5mL of2g/L resazurin becomes0.5G_PER_L. This must not drive MIM whole-stock identity or concentration calculations.
